packageIdentity.result: Every available copy hashes to the frozen producer hashes; historical and final projection copies checked against the same hashes. No 4d proof substituted.

sourceLink.audit: The immutable producer manifest diagnostic return-field is mistyped; source-map-report-note explains the independent frozen validation of all four actual PDB CDI mappings and 58 source checksums. Do not describe /_* as the actual CDI mapping.

consumer.sdkPin: 8.0.319; consumer/global.json uses latestFeature and prerelease disabled

assertions.seededRepeatability: Two Generate calls with identical start/end, Seed=42, Frequency=60 have equal point and timing sequences.
assertions.endpoints: Exact requested start (-12.5,25.25) and end (500,280.75); default-seed generation also checks endpoints and at least two points.
assertions.finiteCoordinatesAndTimings: Every X/Y and timing is finite; point/timing counts equal.
assertions.monotonicTiming: Timing[0] == 0, final timing > 0, and each adjacent timing is nondecreasing.
assertions.invalidInput: NaN, positive infinity and negative infinity start X are each required to throw ArgumentOutOfRangeException (NaN is also checked separately).
assertions.embeddedDatasetNonmutation: SHA-256 of embedded trajectories.json.gz equals 1bf3af168719a580e2c5d6fb439f894f9bfff72fc90147149cc531dee80b6203 before and after generation.
assertions.concurrentGeneration: Task.WhenAll runs eight independently seeded calls; asserts result count 8 and requested endpoints on every result.
assertions.optionalEntropy: Not separately tested; no entropy-quality claim.

consumer.observed: Consumer passed; generated 33 points and the expected dataset resource digest. No general child-process absence assertion: no process-table sampling is recorded.

unitTests.parityScope: 160 pinned upstream parity cases, with exact timing and point-coordinate tolerance 1e-9; 3 intermediate-stage cases with selection tolerance 1e-12 and other stage tolerance 1e-9; fixture hashes/source provenance pinned; RNG bitstream/distribution vectors. Not universal cross-implementation, browser, or whole-product parity.
unitTests.additionalChecks: Tests assert endpoint/timing invariants, deterministic repeated seeds, invalid coordinates/options, read-only result collections, and 1,000 concurrent calls with shared dataset hash unchanged.

benchmark.method: Three separate processes; each times one first generation (cold), executes 20 untimed warmups, then times 500 calls; p50/p95 use sorted nearest-rank index ceil(p*n)-1; allocated bytes are GC total-allocation delta divided by 500.
benchmark.interpretation: 10 ms p95 is an investigative budget, not a universal pass threshold; run 1 and run 2 exceed it. Measurements are descriptive, not a performance gate.

historicalComparison.taskCompletion: All seven page records in each lane report taskCompleted=true; hover/click completion also true.
historicalComparison.defaults: All old baseline option defaults are unchanged. Candidate adds EnableDiagnostics=false, DiagnosticsCapacity=256, MouseAlgorithm=Bezier, RandomSeed=null, CursoryFrequency=60, CursoryFrequencyRandomizer=1, CursoryDirectness=0.65, CursoryMovementDeadlineMilliseconds=2000, CompatibilityMode=Legacy, ActionDeadlineMilliseconds=30000, TypingDeadlineMilliseconds=30000.
historicalComparison.limitation: Baseline RNG is not seedable. No paired trajectory comparison or causal performance regression claim.

correspondenceAndReleaseCaveats.sourceProgramCorrespondence: 432/432 compared entries across 23 types; zero differences. No whole-PE byte-identity claim.
